description: Find issuers of corporate bonds listed on GPW Catalyst (Poland) by name, ticker prefix or sector. Returns name, sector, number of listed series, next maturity and the source page. Szukanie emitentów obligacji korporacyjnych z Catalyst.

query.description: Issuer name, short name or part of it, e.g. "Kruk". Empty = list all.

sector.description: Optional sector filter (Polish label fragment), e.g. "Deweloperzy".

name: search_issuers
title: Search Catalyst bond issuers
